kind: read-only concrete CT packed Graph/provider execution seam
status: design only: no source edit, build, GPU, network or payload read
conclusion: Use the existing graph_route_cuda private RegionProvider decorator pattern on the original torch_cuda provider, and a private same-build CT-linear descriptor prepared by that same provider. A normal public Decode/View/MatMul Graph remains the input; no new public operation, common Graph scheduling rule, ggml executor or Context/Queue is needed.

actual_seam.fact: Current working exemplar retains original ProviderVTable, exposes only a Graph region extension, forwards native propose/resources/prepare and shared_submit through the original prepared artifact. Pattern is not gated by the leaf provider supporting public MatMul.

ProviderAccess::with_vtable copies the original Provider payload/config owner and only changes its same-build vtable pointer. Static decorated/original table lifetimes and all original create/destroy/context/query delegates must be retained.

Existing original Context, resource binding, QueueSequence stream and PreparedVTable already execute packed MLX kernels. Current CT ArtifactWeightDecode instead uses ATen and dense result/copy. Add a distinct private CT branch before the ATen fallback; do not route CT through the MLX affine arithmetic or its format enum.

Default roster currently hardcodes torch_cuda::provider() while its private create_context accepts only ggml/native decorations. Append a private optional artifacts Provider argument analogous to native; Graph context passes CT-decorated torch provider, Direct retains the original. No public default-policy change is needed.

with_defaults<Family::kTorch,DefaultScope::kGraph> snapshots its first original table. All default Graph assembly calls must consistently supply the decorated table from first use; its prepare and other query hooks remain original. Do not redecorate an already configured table or create a second provider roster.

suggested_fields: decoded operand dtype after actual Decode/final Cast edges; infer obtains scale dtype from ports
private_operation.ports: A,codes[,packed_zero],scale -> original MatMul output. Asymmetric4 uses A,codes,Z,scale; symmetric4 omits Z.
private_operation.infer: Delegate packed source shape/type validation to the original ArtifactWeightDecode::infer_output_descriptions, derive its exact decoded [N,K] type, use checked metadata transpose [K,N], then original MatMul inference. Do not duplicate a public format/schema or change the public MatMul operation.
private_operation.execution: Recognized/proposed/prepared by artifact_provider.cc under its original Context and ProviderPreparedVTable; reuse mlx_packed_kernel row-dot launch substrate with a distinct typed CT loader. No whole-W at::Tensor, shifts tensor or dense allocation for the packed branch. The loader/launch implementation is still missing and must be implemented/tested.

matching.candidate: bounded Decode -> exact rank2 transpose View -> MatMul(F32 accumulation), optional explicit lossless F16/BF16->F32 widen only if its position/type is retained; start with the demonstrated dense 2D ports
matching.nodes: Own Decode and every admitted intermediate View/Cast plus terminal MatMul. Decode is the first math node, so do not emit a candidate that starts by swallowing an unrelated free metadata boundary; no rank0 workaround.
matching.boundary: Original A,codes,Z,scales actual ValueIds/resources. A may have external readers/published observations. The decoded W and removed internal View/Cast values must be private to this one MatMul, with original Graph outputs/view aliases/control escapes checked. Published decoded W or other readers retain the old decomposition initially.
matching.discovery: One allocator-backed value/reader/control index, bounded pattern walks and RegionProposalWriter::try_add. Qualification rechecks exact request.nodes/inputs/outputs and descriptions, with no full graph scan per accepted region. Preserve existing proposal limits and route policy.
matching.selection: Use truthful cost/runtime from the private original-provider proposal. No ggml eligibility prefilter, model name/weight role/shape whitelist, or fabricated zero-cost decode. CompileReport plus a focused physical check must demonstrate actual selection before claiming packed execution.

numerical_boundaries: Codes/zeros are treated as U32 bit patterns. The integer centered difference is exactly representable in F16/BF16/F32; do not perform a floating affine -zp*scale substitution.

The scale-dtype product RNE is mandatory before MatMul: BF16 scale requires BF16_RNE(diff*scale), F16 requires F16_RNE, F32 requires original F32 multiply rounding. An explicit F32 decode output or Cast widens that already rounded value; it does not authorize F32-only dequantization.

If an explicit decode output changes to another low dtype, preserve that second conversion or decline the pattern initially. Public MatMul requires compatible operand/output types and its declared F32 accumulation; do not silently narrow A or move scale after dot.

The existing public MatMul permits a different legal F32 reduction tree, not changed weight decode/activation operands. Final output RNE is retained. Zero/nonfinite/subnormal behavior and no-FTZ product boundaries need focused oracle/compiled-math evidence for the new kernel, not inference from the format name.

The entire conversion chain is semantic: e.g. BF16 scale product -> BF16 RNE -> requested F16 RNE -> optional exact F32 widen -> MatMul F16 or F32 operand as originally described. A same-build descriptor must encode the actual sequence or conservatively decline unsupported secondary conversion, rather than recording just the final dtype. The public MatMul inferred activation/output dtype remains authoritative; F32 accumulation never implies F32 operands/output.

ownership.no_repack_initial: No new constant cache entry is required if original packed buffers are consumed directly. Artifact stores immutable shape/options/port mappings, not borrowed request spans or source data addresses.
ownership.original_roots: request.constants/constant_origins describe exact immutable boundary Views with real root and byte offset (region_provider.h:274-290). Use ordinary Graph-selected input resources/ConstantBindings or dynamic input leases; do not infer immutable ownership from a raw pointer, filename or matching descriptor.
ownership.lifetime: Ordinary Graph retains canonical/materialized constants and input permissions. Shared submit borrows their actual ConstTensorViews only under original QueueSequence/Completion retention, and writes the original caller destination with unchanged disjoint/permission checks. Region wrapper retains the original prepared artifact/context owner, not a second resource or executor.
ownership.dynamic: A structural packed kernel need not assume weights are immutable to be mathematically valid; if dynamic ports are admitted they are read fresh each submit under their actual episode leases. Never cache their payload identity or permission. A first implementation may decline unsupported dynamic/layout cases explicitly.
ownership.if_future_repack: If packing is later introduced, use ConstantArtifactAccess with all real roots/View offsets/desc/options and owned retirement; no ad hoc address-keyed global cache. This is not necessary for the initial no-repack branch.

provenance_loss.fact: The current fragment records decode in a separate cold preparation object, then makes a new dense Graph constant from outputs[0] and sets prepared_constants={0}; only that dense constant + transpose/MatMul are present in the executing Graph. The public Graph has no original code/Z/scale values or decoder node to match.
provenance_loss.existing_CUDA_tests: tests/graph_route_cuda/artifact_test.cc currently builds Graph decode-only outputs from original packed ports. It proves decode/lifecycle, not an existing in-Graph packed linear implementation.
provenance_loss.can_keep_ordinary_calls: Yes: consumer builds original packed constants plus the existing ArtifactWeightDecode node, ordinary exact View and MatMul in the same GraphBuilder/compile call using the default Graph CUDA context. The private candidate can then select without a new consumer API. If consumer binds only predecoded dense W, identity is irretrievably absent from that Graph; keep dense MatMul and change that consumer assembly explicitly rather than reverse-infer codec.
provenance_loss.constant_folding: Graph core does not globally erase/rewrite ArtifactWeightDecode into a packed provenance record. ggml_cuda constant_expressions only handles recipes its own TensorProgram can lower; current TensorProgram has no ArtifactWeightDecode support. Do not assume its private prepared-output cache can recover a separately decoded CT constant.

compile_order_proof.fact: make_specialized_graph allocates/copies the full original values/nodes/edges/constants/dependencies and only binds concrete descriptors/shape operands. No tensor-value execution or constant-node folding occurs.

bind_constants accepts only the original Graph ValueKind::kConstant list and validates bindings/owners/leases. It registers source tensors without executing pure node operations; then prepare_placed_steps begins.

Actual leaf proposals and all RegionProvider proposals/resource queries run on the original specialized Graph before heavy artifact creation or canonical constant copies. Route search is initialized with those candidates. A CT region can see Decode/View/MatMul in full at this point.

Only after a complete physical route and output transfers exist does materialize_constants copy original declared immutable roots/metadata aliases into the selected storage. It is a byte-copy transaction over original constant bindings, not an evaluator for ArtifactWeightDecode or other pure nodes.

The selected region gets real packed constant boundary views/owners and its compile callback. ggml provider-local constant_expressions::prepare runs only here on its selected private recipe, after candidate selection; it neither rewrites the input Graph nor globally erases decoder nodes before other providers can propose.

On candidate retry prepared_values/artifacts are cleared; logical Graph identities stay intact. Even provider-created immutable prepared outputs keep logical node identities for data/control ordering. No ordering change or CT whitelist is needed to expose the in-Graph pattern today.

compile_order_conclusion: Confirmed from actual compile path: putting original packed constants and Decode/View/MatMul into one normal Graph is sufficient to preserve pattern identity until private region proposals. Current blockers are missing private CT packed execution/candidate/default decoration and consumers that split decode into a different Graph, not an early common constant-fold pass.

fixture_owned_binding_docs.fact: Guide already states InvocationOptions::resources or prepare_resources and shows .resources=ResourceOptions before ReadLease/WriteLease binding. Apple common fixture omission was corrected with the existing factory option, not a core/API/documentation gap.
